mainTopic: Does זריקת דמים take effect on the meat of קדשי קדשים that left the עזרה before the blood was sprinkled? The מחלוקת between רבי אליעזר and רבי עקיבא about מעילה, פיגול, נותר and טמא.
overview: The משנה discusses meat of קדשי קדשים that left the עזרה before its blood was sprinkled. רבי אליעזר holds the sprinkling does not work on it, so מעילה remains and there is no liability for פיגול, נותר or eating while טמא. רבי עקיבא holds the sprinkling does work, so מעילה ends and those prohibitions apply. He proves this with a קל וחומר from a lost חטאת that was replaced and then found: if one animal's blood exempts the other animal's meat, surely it exempts its own meat. The משנה then brings the same argument about אימורין of קדשים קלים, where sprinkling creates מעילה instead of ending it. The גמרא asks why both disputes are needed, and answers that each one blocks a different wrong guess about רבי אליעזר or רבי עקיבא. רבי יוחנן then limits רבי עקיבא's rule to meat that only partly left the עזרה. רב אסי begins to answer him with a tradition from the sages of בבל, which continues on the next amud.

steps.title: The case: holy meat that went out before the blood was sprinkled
steps.stepSummary: The משנה introduces the case of meat of קדשי קדשים that left its proper area before זריקת דמים.
steps.simpleTranslation: משנה: The meat of the most holy offerings that went out (of the courtyard) before the blood was sprinkled.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה is setting up the case that the two תנאים will argue about in the next steps. Meat from a most-holy קרבן left the courtyard before its blood was sprinkled.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Meat of קדשי קדשים may only be eaten inside the courtyard, so meat that goes out becomes פסול. Normally, sprinkling the blood is the act that 'releases' the meat to the כהנים. The question is whether sprinkling still does that when the meat has already gone out.

keyTerms.meaning: Short for מַתְנִיתִין, 'our משנה'
The most holy category of offerings (such as חטאת and אשם), eaten only in the courtyard
Sprinkling the blood on the מזבח, the key act that completes the offering
That went out of its permitted area, which makes it פסול

steps.confusionAlert: Don't mix up the order. The meat went out FIRST, and only afterward was the blood sprinkled. The whole argument is whether that later sprinkling still counts for this meat.

phrases.english: MISHNA:
The meat of offerings of the most sacred order
that went out before the sprinkling of the blood,
phrases.notes: 'Went out' means it left the courtyard, the only place this kind of meat may be.

steps.triggerLanguage: מַתְנִי׳ בְּשַׂר קׇדְשֵׁי קָדָשִׁים שֶׁיָּצָא לִפְנֵי זְרִיקַת דָּמִים
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Sets up the case of קדשי קדשים meat that went out before זריקה; no ruling yet.

steps.title: רבי אליעזר: the sprinkling does not work, so מעילה remains
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר rules that מעילה still applies, and there is no liability for פיגול, נותר or eating while טמא.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אליעזר says: One is liable for misusing it, and one is not liable for it because of פיגול, נותר, or impurity.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אליעזר gives his ruling. Since the meat went out, the sprinkling does not take effect on it, so it stays fully הקדש.
steps.deeperAnalysis: מעילה normally ends once the blood is sprinkled, because the meat then belongs to the כהנים. רבי אליעזר holds the sprinkling did nothing for meat that went out, so מעילה continues. For the same reason, the prohibitions of פיגול, נותר and טמא never start, since they only apply to meat that the sprinkling made permitted.

keyTerms.meaning: One is liable for מְעִילָה (misusing הקדש) with it
An offering made invalid by wrong intent about time, such as planning to eat it too late
Meat of a קרבן left over past its time limit
Ritually impure; here, eating the meat while impure

steps.whyThisMatters: This shows that מעילה on one side, and פיגול/נותר/טמא on the other, are linked to the same act. If the sprinkling works, מעילה ends and the eating-prohibitions begin. If it doesn't work, neither change happens.

phrases.english: Rabbi Eliezer says: One is liable for misusing it,
and one is not liable for it
due to piggul, notar, or ritual impurity.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the first opinion on the case set up in step 1.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The sprinkling does not take effect on meat that went out: מעילה applies; no liability for פיגול, נותר or טמא.

steps.title: רבי עקיבא: the sprinkling works, so מעילה ends
steps.stepSummary: רבי עקיבא rules the opposite: no מעילה, but there is liability for פיגול, נותר and eating while טמא.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי עקיבא says: One is not liable for misusing it, and one is liable for it because of פיגול, נותר, or impurity.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי עקיבא disagrees on both points. He holds that the sprinkling does take effect even on meat that went out.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Because the sprinkling counts, the meat leaves the status of הקדש for מעילה purposes, just like a normal קרבן after זריקה. And because the sprinkling counts, the normal prohibitions of פיגול, נותר and טמא now apply to it. His ruling is the exact mirror image of רבי אליעזר's.

keyTerms.meaning: There is no liability for מעילה with it
One is liable (punishable) for eating it

steps.whatToRemember: The whole מחלוקת comes down to one question: does זריקה work on meat that already went out? רבי אליעזר says no, so מעילה applies and there is no פיגול/נותר/טמא. רבי עקיבא says yes, so there is no מעילה, and פיגול/נותר/טמא apply.

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא אוֹמֵר: אֵין מוֹעֲלִין בּוֹ,
phrases.english: Rabbi Akiva says: One is not liable for misusing it,
and one is liable for it
due to piggul, notar, or ritual impurity.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא אוֹמֵר: אֵין מוֹעֲלִין בּוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Disagrees with רבי אליעזר in step 2 on every point.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The sprinkling takes effect on meat that went out: no מעילה; liability for פיגול, נותר and טמא.

steps.title: רבי עקיבא begins his proof from a lost and replaced חטאת
steps.stepSummary: רבי עקיבא starts to bring a proof from the case of a lost חטאת that was replaced, after which the original was found.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי עקיבא said: But consider one who set aside his חטאת and it got lost, and he set aside another one in its place, and afterward the first one was found, so both of them are standing there.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי עקיבא begins a proof for his view by describing a comparison case. This step only sets up that case; the actual argument continues in the next part of the משנה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In this case there are two animals set aside for one obligation, but only one of them will actually be used. רבי עקיבא is setting up a case where sprinkling the blood of one animal affects the status of a different animal. He will use it to show that sprinkling can take effect even on meat that is not fit to be eaten.

keyTerms.meaning: One who sets aside (designates) an animal for a קרבן
His חַטָּאת, a sin offering, one of the קדשי קדשים
And it was lost
In its place, as a replacement
Standing, meaning both are available and fit to be offered

steps.confusionAlert: This step is not the full proof. It only describes the case. The point רבי עקיבא draws from it comes right after this.

phrases.english: Rabbi Akiva said:
But there is one who designated his sin offering and it was lost,
and he designated another in its place,
and afterward the first one was found,
and both of them are standing.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא: וַהֲרֵי הַמַּפְרִישׁ חַטָּאתוֹ וְאָבְדָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: רבי עקיבא begins supporting his ruling from step 3 against רבי אליעזר.
steps.raayaObject: רבי עקיבא's view that זריקה takes effect even on meat that is not fit to be eaten, ending מעילה.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The case of a lost חטאת that was replaced and then found, so that both animals are present. Steps 5–6 complete the argument from it.

steps.title: One animal's blood exempts the other animal's meat
steps.stepSummary: רבי עקיבא sets up his proof. In the lost חטאת case, sprinkling one animal's blood exempts both its own meat and the other animal's meat from מעילה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Isn't it true that just as its blood exempts its own meat, it also exempts the meat of the other animal?
steps.whatsHappening: רבי עקיבא continues the proof he started in step 4. He states an accepted fact that his main argument will build on in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Two animals were set aside for one חטאת, and either one's blood could have been used. So when the כהן sprinkles one animal's blood, it counts for both, and both animals' meat leaves מעילה. This shows that blood can affect meat that is not physically connected to it.

keyTerms.meaning: Exempts, here meaning it takes the meat out of the law of מעילה
Its fellow, meaning the other animal in the pair
Its own meat

phrases.aramaic: לֹא כְּשֵׁם שֶׁדָּמָהּ פּוֹטֵר אֶת בְּשָׂרָהּ,
phrases.english: Is it not that just as its blood exempts its own meat,
phrases.notes: "Its" means the חטאת whose blood was actually sprinkled.

phrases.aramaic: כָּךְ הוּא פּוֹטֵר אֶת בְּשַׂר חֲבֶרְתָּהּ?
phrases.english: so too it exempts the meat of its fellow animal?
phrases.notes: The "fellow" is the second animal of the lost-and-found pair, whose blood was never sprinkled.

steps.triggerLanguage: לֹא כְּשֵׁם שֶׁדָּמָהּ פּוֹטֵר אֶת בְּשָׂרָהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the case that step 4 started and states the accepted rule that the proof needs.
steps.raayaObject: רבי עקיבא's view that זריקה works on meat that left the עזרה
steps.raayaSupportSource: The case of a lost חטאת that was replaced and then found

steps.title: The קל וחומר: surely the blood exempts its own meat
steps.stepSummary: רבי עקיבא concludes that if the blood can exempt another animal's meat, it surely exempts its own meat, even meat that left the עזרה.
steps.simpleTranslation: If its blood exempted the other animal's meat from מעילה, it is only logical that it should exempt its own meat!
steps.whatsHappening: רבי עקיבא completes his proof with a קל וחומר, an argument from the weaker case to the stronger one.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The other animal's meat has a weak connection to the blood, yet the blood still exempts it. The animal's own meat has a much stronger connection, so leaving the עזרה should not stop the blood from exempting it. So זריקה works on meat that went out, and there is no מעילה, as רבי עקיבא ruled in step 3.

keyTerms.meaning: An argument that if a rule applies in the weaker case, it surely applies in the stronger case
It is only logical, a phrase that signals a קל וחומר
Its own meat
Misusing הקדש, which brings a קרבן and a payment

steps.whatToRemember: רבי עקיבא's key idea: זריקה can reach meat that is not in the עזרה. If it reaches a different animal's meat, it certainly reaches its own meat that went outside.

phrases.aramaic: אִם פָּטַר דָּמָהּ אֶת בְּשַׂר חֲבֶרְתָּהּ מִן הַמְּעִילָה,
phrases.english: If its blood exempted the meat of its fellow animal from מעילה,

phrases.aramaic: דִּין הוּא שֶׁיִּפְטֹר אֶת בְּשַׂר עַצְמָהּ!
phrases.english: it is only logical that it should exempt its own meat!

steps.triggerLanguage: אִם פָּטַר דָּמָהּ אֶת בְּשַׂר חֲבֶרְתָּהּ מִן הַמְּעִילָה, דִּין הוּא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Uses the fact from step 5 as the starting point of a קל וחומר.
steps.raayaObject: Meat of קדשי קדשים that left the עזרה is exempted from מעילה by זריקה
steps.raayaSupportSource: A קל וחומר from the blood exempting the other animal's meat in the lost חטאת case

steps.title: A new case: אימורין of קדשים קלים that left before זריקה
steps.stepSummary: The משנה introduces a second case: the altar parts of lighter קרבנות that left the עזרה before the blood was sprinkled.
steps.simpleTranslation: The altar parts of קדשים קלים that went out before the sprinkling of the blood:
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה is setting up a new case. The rulings of רבי אליעזר and רבי עקיבא come in the next two steps.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In קדשים קלים, the meat and אימורין are not subject to מעילה before זריקה. The זריקה is what makes the אימורין belong to the מזבח, and only then does מעילה apply. So the question here is whether זריקה can bring the אימורין into מעילה if they were outside the עזרה when it happened.

keyTerms.meaning: The fats and parts of a קרבן that are burned on the מזבח
Offerings of lesser holiness, such as a שלמים
Sprinkling the blood on the מזבח
That went out of the עזרה

steps.confusionAlert: Don't think the two רבנן switched sides. In קדשי קדשים, זריקה removes מעילה from the meat. In קדשים קלים, זריקה creates מעילה on the אימורין. So when רבי עקיבא says here that there IS מעילה, he is still saying the same thing: זריקה works on what went out.

phrases.english: The altar portions of offerings of lesser sanctity
that went out before the sprinkling of the blood,

steps.triggerLanguage: אֵימוּרַי קָדָשִׁים קַלִּים שֶׁיָּצְאוּ לִפְנֵי זְרִיקַת דָּמִים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Leaves the proof and brings a parallel case where the same מחלוקת applies.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Sets up the case of אימורי קדשים קלים that left before זריקה

steps.title: רבי אליעזר: no מעילה and no liability for פיגול, נותר or טמא
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר rules that these אימורין have no מעילה, and one is not liable for eating them as פיגול, נותר, or while טמא.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אליעזר says: there is no מעילה with them, and one is not liable for them because of פיגול, נותר or טמא.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אליעזר gives his ruling on the new case.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי אליעזר holds that זריקה does not work on parts that are outside. So the אימורין never become the מזבח's portion, and מעילה never starts. Without a valid זריקה, the prohibitions of פיגול, נותר and טמא do not apply either. This fits his ruling in step 2.

keyTerms.meaning: One is liable for מעילה
A קרבן made invalid by an improper intention about the time for eating it
Meat left over past its time limit
Eating קדשים while ritually impure

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר: אֵין מוֹעֲלִין בָּהֶן,
phrases.english: Rabbi Eliezer says: One is not liable for misusing them,
and one is not liable for them
due to פיגול, נותר, or impurity.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר: אֵין מוֹעֲלִין בָּהֶן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives רבי אליעזר's ruling on the case from step 7.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: זריקה does not work on אימורין that went out, so there is no מעילה and no liability for פיגול, נותר or טמא.

steps.title: רבי עקיבא: there is מעילה and liability for פיגול, נותר and טמא
steps.stepSummary: רבי עקיבא rules that these אימורין do have מעילה, and one is liable for eating them as פיגול, נותר, or while טמא.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי עקיבא says: there is מעילה with them, and one is liable for them because of פיגול, נותר and טמא.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי עקיבא gives his opposite ruling, which ends this section of the משנה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי עקיבא holds that זריקה works even on parts that are outside the עזרה. So the זריקה makes the אימורין the מזבח's portion, and מעילה applies. Since the זריקה counts, the prohibitions of פיגול, נותר and טמא also apply.

keyTerms.meaning: One is liable to punishment
Because of, on account of

steps.whatToRemember: In both cases, רבי עקיבא holds that זריקה works on what went out, and רבי אליעזר holds it does not. The practical result only looks reversed because זריקה removes מעילה in קדשי קדשים but creates it in קדשים קלים.

phrases.english: Rabbi Akiva says: One is liable for misusing them,
and one is liable for them
due to פיגול, נותר, or impurity.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the opposite ruling to רבי אליעזר's in step 8.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: זריקה works on אימורין that went out, so there is מעילה and liability for פיגול, נותר and טמא.

steps.title: Why does the משנה need two disputes?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא opens by asking why the משנה lists two separate disputes between רבי אליעזר and רבי עקיבא.
steps.simpleTranslation: גמרא: Why do I need these two cases?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts by asking why the משנה needed to teach both disputes. It seems that one dispute would have been enough.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both disputes seem to turn on the same question. Does sprinkling the blood count when the meat or אימורין already left the עזרה? If the principle is the same, teaching it twice looks unnecessary. The גמרא is setting up its answer that each case teaches something new.

keyTerms.meaning: The Talmud's discussion of the משנה
Two (here: the two disputes)
Why do I need it? A question about something that seems repeated

phrases.english: GEMARA:
Why do I need these two?
phrases.notes: "These two" means the קדשי קדשים dispute from Steps 1–3 and the קדשים קלים dispute from Steps 7–9.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from the משנה to the גמרא and questions why the משנה contains both disputes
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why the משנה needs to teach both the קדשי קדשים dispute and the קדשים קלים dispute

steps.title: If only the קדשי קדשים case were taught
steps.stepSummary: Both cases are needed. From the קדשי קדשים case alone, one might think רבי אליעזר holds that only proper sprinkling takes the meat out of מעילה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Both are necessary. If the dispute were stated only about קדשי קדשים, I would have thought that only there רבי אליעזר says there is מעילה. The reason would be that proper sprinkling takes an offering out of מעילה, but improper sprinkling does not.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that both cases are needed. It begins with what we might wrongly think if we only had the קדשי קדשים case.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Meat of קדשי קדשים has מעילה before the blood is sprinkled. Sprinkling makes the meat permitted to כהנים, so it takes the meat out of מעילה. From this case alone, we might think רבי אליעזר's view is narrow: improper sprinkling cannot do that job of taking the meat out.

keyTerms.meaning: They are needed. Each case teaches something the other does not
I would have thought. This introduces a mistaken first idea
Sprinkling the blood on the מזבח
Properly, in its correct way
Takes the item out of the status of מעילה

steps.confusionAlert: This is only a הוה אמינא, meaning what we would have thought. The גמרא is not saying this is רבי אליעזר's real limit. It is explaining why the משנה needed a second case.

phrases.english: They are necessary,
for if it were stated about offerings of the most sacred order,
I would have said:

phrases.aramaic: בְּהָא קָא אָמַר רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר מוֹעֲלִין בּוֹ,
phrases.english: it is in this case that Rabbi Eliezer says one is liable for misusing it,
because sprinkling done properly
removes it from misuse,

phrases.aramaic: שֶׁלֹּא כְּתִיקְנָהּ – לָא מַפְּקָא מִידֵי מְעִילָה.
phrases.english: but improperly, it does not remove it from misuse.
phrases.notes: "Improperly" here means the meat had already left the עזרה when the blood was sprinkled.

steps.triggerLanguage: צְרִיכִי, דְּאִי אִיתְּמַר בְּקׇדְשֵׁי קָדָשִׁים, הֲוָה אָמֵינָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Begins answering the question of Step 10 with the צריכותא format
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Each case is needed. The first half shows what we would wrongly infer from the קדשי קדשים case alone.

steps.title: Then רבי אליעזר might agree when sprinkling brings into מעילה
steps.stepSummary: Continuing the mistaken idea: when sprinkling brings something into מעילה, we might think רבי אליעזר agrees with רבי עקיבא that even improper sprinkling works.
steps.simpleTranslation: But for bringing an offering into מעילה, he would agree with רבי עקיבא that even improper sprinkling brings it into מעילה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes the mistaken idea we would have had from the קדשי קדשים case. We might have thought רבי אליעזר agrees with רבי עקיבא in the opposite situation, where sprinkling brings something into מעילה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The אימורין of קדשים קלים have no מעילה before the blood is sprinkled. The sprinkling is what gives them to the מזבח and brings them into מעילה. If only the first case were taught, we might think improper sprinkling still works in this stricter direction. That is why the משנה needed to teach the second dispute, where רבי אליעזר disagrees there too.

keyTerms.meaning: To bring an item into the status of מעילה
He agrees, concedes
Improperly, not in its correct way

steps.whatToRemember: Sprinkling can work in two directions. In קדשי קדשים it takes the meat out of מעילה. In קדשים קלים it brings the אימורין into מעילה. The קדשים קלים dispute is needed to show that רבי אליעזר holds his view in both directions.

phrases.english: but with regard to bringing it into misuse,
phrases.notes: This refers to the קדשים קלים case, where sprinkling is what makes the אימורין subject to מעילה.

phrases.english: he concedes to Rabbi Akiva
that even when done improperly
it brings it into misuse.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the mistaken first idea begun in Step 11
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Without the קדשים קלים case, we might think רבי אליעזר agrees that improper sprinkling brings the אימורין into מעילה.

steps.title: If only the קדשים קלים case were taught
steps.stepSummary: Now the other side: from the קדשים קלים case alone, one might think רבי עקיבא counts improper sprinkling only for bringing into מעילה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if it were stated only about קדשים קלים, I would have thought that only there רבי עקיבא says there is מעילה. The reason would be that even improper sprinkling brings an offering into מעילה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא turns to the second half of its answer and explains what we would wrongly think from the קדשים קלים case alone. The next step finishes this idea.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In קדשים קלים, רבי עקיבא says improper sprinkling still brings the אימורין into מעילה. From that case alone, we might think he counts improper sprinkling only in this stricter direction. The גמרא will go on to show why the קדשי קדשים case is needed to teach that he counts it for taking meat out of מעילה too.

keyTerms.meaning: Offerings of lesser holiness, like a שלמים
One is liable for misusing holy property

phrases.english: And if it were stated about offerings of lesser sanctity,
I would have said:

phrases.aramaic: גַּבֵּי קָדָשִׁים קַלִּים הוּא דְּאָמַר רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא
phrases.english: it is regarding offerings of lesser sanctity that Rabbi Akiva said
one is liable for misusing them,
because even sprinkling done improperly
brings it into misuse,

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאִי אִיתְּמַר גַּבֵּי קָדָשִׁים קַלִּים, הֲוָה אָמֵינָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Mirrors Steps 11–12 from the other side: explains why the קדשי קדשים case is also needed
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: From the קדשים קלים case alone, we might think רבי עקיבא's view applies only where sprinkling brings into מעילה.

steps.title: Why the משנה must teach both cases
steps.stepSummary: Without the קדשי קדשים case, we might think רבי עקיבא agrees that improper sprinkling cannot take meat out of מעילה, so the משנה teaches both disputes.
steps.simpleTranslation: But with קדשי קדשים, where the sprinkling serves to take the meat out of מעילה, we might think that improper sprinkling does not take it out of מעילה. So the משנה teaches us both cases.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes its answer. It explains the mistake we might have made about רבי עקיבא, and says this is why the משנה needed to record both disputes.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Taking something out of מעילה is a leniency. So one might think רבי עקיבא would let only a proper sprinkling do that. The קדשי קדשים case shows that for רבי עקיבא, even improper sprinkling takes the meat out of מעילה.

keyTerms.meaning: Offerings of the most sacred order. Before the blood is sprinkled their meat has מעילה, and after the sprinkling it does not.
To take out. Here it means the sprinkling removes the meat from מעילה.
Not done properly. Here, a sprinkling done when the offering has a problem that makes it invalid.
This teaches us. It shows what we learn from the source.

steps.whatToRemember: Each case in the משנה protects us from a different wrong guess. The קדשי קדשים case shows that רבי עקיבא counts improper sprinkling even when it takes meat out of מעילה. The קדשים קלים case shows that רבי אליעזר does not count it even when it brings something into מעילה.

phrases.english: But with offerings of the most sacred order,
where it serves to take out,
phrases.notes: The 'it' is the sprinkling of the blood, which takes the meat out of מעילה.

phrases.english: improper sprinkling
does not take it out of the status of misuse,
so it teaches us otherwise.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the wrong guess about רבי עקיבא that began in step 13, and closes the answer to the question in step 10.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Both disputes are needed. Each one blocks a wrong guess: one about רבי אליעזר and one about רבי עקיבא.

steps.title: רבי יוחנן: רבי עקיבא's rule applies only when part of the meat left
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן limits רבי עקיבא's view. Sprinkling takes the meat out of מעילה only if part of it left the courtyard, not if all of it left.
steps.simpleTranslation: It was stated: רבי יוחנן said that when רבי עקיבא said sprinkling works for meat that went out, he meant meat that only partly went out. If all of it went out, רבי עקיבא did not say this.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a new statement. רבי יוחנן explains how far רבי עקיבא's ruling in the משנה reaches.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the משנה, רבי עקיבא held that sprinkling takes meat that left the courtyard out of מעילה. רבי יוחנן says this applies only when some of the meat stayed inside, so the sprinkling works on the part inside and carries over to the part outside. If the whole piece left, the sprinkling does not remove it from מעילה.

keyTerms.meaning: Sprinkling or tossing the blood of an offering on the מזבח.
Is effective; it works.
Meat that went out of the area where it must stay, which makes it invalid.
Part of it.
All of it.

steps.confusionAlert: רבי יוחנן is not arguing with רבי עקיבא. He is explaining that רבי עקיבא's rule was only said about meat that partly left the courtyard.

phrases.english: It was stated: Rabbi Yoḥanan said:
When Rabbi Akiva said
that sprinkling is effective for meat that went out,
he meant where part of it went out,
but if all of it went out,
Rabbi Akiva did not say so.

steps.triggerLanguage: אִתְּמַר, אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: כִּי אָמַר רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new topic: how far רבי עקיבא's ruling in the משנה reaches.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי עקיבא, sprinkling takes meat that left the courtyard out of מעילה only if part of it stayed inside. If all of it went out, it does not.

steps.title: רב אסי begins answering רבי יוחנן with a tradition from בבל
steps.stepSummary: רב אסי tells רבי יוחנן that his colleagues in בבל already taught him something on this subject. The rest of his words continue in the next section.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב אסי said to רבי יוחנן: My colleagues in the exile already taught me...
steps.whatsHappening: This is a setup line. רב אסי is starting to bring a teaching from the sages of בבל in response to רבי יוחנן, and the actual content comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Saying 'my colleagues already taught me' signals that רב אסי has an earlier tradition on this exact question. We will need to see whether it supports רבי יוחנן's limit or pushes back against it.

keyTerms.meaning: My colleagues in the exile, meaning the sages of בבל.
They already taught me.

phrases.aramaic: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב אַסִּי לְרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן:
phrases.english: Rav Asi said to Rabbi Yoḥanan:
My colleagues in the exile already taught me

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב אַסִּי לְרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: כְּבָר לִימְּדוּנִי חֲבֵירַי שֶׁבַּגּוֹלָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Responds to רבי יוחנן's statement in step 15 by starting to quote an earlier tradition from בבל.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי יוחנן's limit that רבי עקיבא's rule applies only when part of the meat left the courtyard.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רב אסי begins quoting a tradition he already received from the sages of בבל. Its content comes next, and it may support or push back against רבי יוחנן's limit.
